_comment: Editorial content for UVIC. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: the company's own brand assets are not licence-cleared. Add imagePath/imageSource/imageLicence together when a real one is available. The chief executive is null because the company's published board listings render the chief executive and chair roles ambiguously and could not be resolved without guessing.
description: The Universal Insurance Company Limited is a Pakistani general insurer based in Lahore, operating from Universal Insurance House on Shahrah-e-Quaid-e-Azam. It writes general insurance and runs a separate risk-management team and an engineering group that work with clients to identify exposures and advise on loss prevention, alongside technically qualified staff in civil, mechanical, metallurgy and electronics disciplines.
headOffice: Universal Insurance House, 63 Shahrah-e-Quaid-e-Azam, Lahore 54000, Pakistan
sourceNote: Company website (uic.com.pk registered-office page: head office address, telephone, fax and registration number; the home page for the risk-management and engineering-team description), read 2026-10-17. A note on the source: the site's home page also carries a block of unrelated injected text, so only the corporate-information and address content was used. Quarterly reports on the site list the chief executive and chairman inconsistently across tables, so ceo is null.
